faqs.question_en: Can I pick up my bahulu at the shop?
faqs.answer_en: Yes. Staff will confirm your pickup time with you on WhatsApp.
faqs.question_ms: Boleh saya ambil bahulu di kedai?
faqs.answer_ms: Boleh. Staf akan sahkan masa ambil dengan anda melalui WhatsApp.

faqs.question_en: How should I store bahulu and how long does it stay fresh?
faqs.answer_en: Keep it in an airtight container. The best-before date is printed on each pack.
faqs.question_ms: Bagaimana nak simpan bahulu dan berapa lama ia tahan?
faqs.answer_ms: Simpan dalam bekas kedap udara. Tarikh luput dicetak pada setiap pek.

faqs.question_en: Can I buy bahulu as a gift or souvenir?
faqs.answer_en: Yes. Ask staff on WhatsApp about gift packs that are available.
faqs.question_ms: Boleh beli bahulu untuk hadiah atau cenderahati?
faqs.answer_ms: Boleh. Tanya staf melalui WhatsApp tentang pek hadiah yang ada.

faqs.answer_en: Our shop location is on our Google Maps listing. Search for Bahulu Berry Cameron.
faqs.answer_ms: Lokasi kedai kami ada di Google Maps. Cari Bahulu Berry Cameron.
